newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end lower on P&U 39 Skr dive.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end lower on P&U 39 Skr dive.

text.p: Swedish shares ended lower on Wednesday, pulled down by drugs group Pharmacia & Upjohn's dive after the company said first quarter sales fell six percent.
The exchange's general index fell 0.39 percent to 2,608.75 in turnover of 7.56 billion crowns.
P&U plummeted 39 crowns to 230. The group saw first quarter EPS before non-recurring charges falling by about 16 percent.
"Pharmacia & Upjohn was a horror story," a dealer said. "Everybody was already affected by Astra's bad report and when Pharmacia released this, the market ran out of steam."
Astra released a lower than expected first quarter earnings report on Monday and fell for the third consecutive day after starting higher, down 4.5 crowns to 302.
Vehicle maker Volvo was also pulled along in the general downswirl and ended one crown lower at 192.5. The share opened higher on the group's first quarter earnings report.
Engineer Atlas Copco dropped 11 crowns to 188 after the company said it saw no signs of improvement in the European construction market.
Swedbank rose six to 144 after posting a profit in line with expectations.
